<ls>P. IV. 1. 122</ls> Belonging to,
 descended or sprung from, Atri.

.²1 A descendant of Atri.
.²2 The head of the descendants of Atri.
.²3 A priest closely related to the Sadasya.
.²4 An epithet of Śiva. 
.²5 An essential humor or juice of the body, lymph.

.²1 A female descendant of Atri; {#gotrapraSaMsArTamAtrezyA avaDasaMkIrtanam .#}
 {#na cApannasattvA AtreyI . gotraM hyetat .#} <ls>ŚB. on MS. 6. 1. 9</ls>.
.²2 The wife of Atri.
.²3 A woman in her courses ({#rajasvalA#}); <ls>Ms. 11. 87</ls>; <ls>Y. 3. 251</ls>.
.²4 Any woman of the Brāhmaṇical order.
.²5 <ab>N.</ab> of a river in the north of Bengal, also called Tista.
.²6 A pregnant woman; <ls>Mb. 12. 165. 54</ls>; {#AtreyImApannagarBAmAhuH . atra#}
 {#kukzO asyA vidyata ityAtreyI .#} <ls>ŚB. on MS. 6. 1. 7</ls>.
